reasons.NS: no distinguishing scope: the token is unscoped or carries only container scopes shared by other roles
reasons.ID: the grammar encodes the identifier text in the scope (variable.other.unknown.<name>); a rule would match one spelling, not the role
reasons.SS: the grammar gives this token the same innermost scope as a token of another role; only containers differ, and they do not separate the roles
reasons.GE: the grammar does not tokenize this construct at all
reasons.SV: the language server labels this token the same as a token of another role, or emits nothing for it
reasons.DV: the servers disagree; by P3 the server verdict stands, so the colour depends on the server in use
reasons.ENV: environment limit E-01 (rust-analyzer cannot resolve std macros on this toolchain)
reasons.NEEDS-SERVER: only a language server can tell this role; the grammar alone gives the declared fallback colour
reasons.DESIGN: deliberate: a multi-part token is coloured part by part as the meaning table says (not a limit)
reasons.SPLIT: the grammar splits the token into parts with different scopes; the parts are coloured as designed or the split itself is the limit
